docs.title: Vigil Insurance: Proactive Safety Agent
docs.text: Welcome to the documentation for the Proactive Safety Agent ecosystem. This project demonstrates an autonomous AI team built with the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) that monitors, triages, and mitigates vehicle safety risks in real-time.

docs.title: The Vision
docs.text:
Traditional insurance is reactive. Vigil Insurance is proactive.

Instead of waiting for a claim, our AI agents monitor global recall databases (like NHTSA), identify affected policyholders, and autonomously coordinate solutions—like dispatching a Waymo to their home and booking priority repair slots at local dealerships—before an accident ever happens.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Autonomous Detection: Continuous monitoring of vehicle recall APIs.
  • AI-Driven Triage: Gemini-powered risk assessment and severity classification.
  • A2A Coordination: Agent-to-Agent protocols for Waymo dispatches and Dealer bookings.
  • Live Command Center: A high-fidelity React dashboard providing real-time telemetry of agent activity.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: To get the system running locally, head over to the Setup Guide.

docs.title: Agents & Tools
docs.text: The core of the system is composed of four specialized agents, each with a specific mission and set of capabilities.

docs.title: 1. MonitorAgent
docs.text: Mission: The "Eyes" of the system. - Tools: - fetch_recalls: Simulated scan of NHTSA database. - get_affected_policyholders: Cross-references VINs with the policy database. - update_crm_dashboard: Marks vehicles as "Recall Detected".

docs.title: 2. TriageAgent
docs.text: Mission: The "Brains" of the system. - Tools: - search_safety_manual: Performs a RAG-style search over vehicle manuals to understand specific risks (e.g., "Airbag inflator rupture"). - update_crm_dashboard: Upgrades status to "Critical" or "High Risk".

docs.title: 3. OutreachAgent
docs.text: Mission: The "Arms" of the system (Action-oriented). - Tools: - dispatch_uber_a2a (Rebranded as Waymo): Triggers an Agent-to-Agent protocol to send an autonomous vehicle. - book_dealer_repair_a2a: Coordinates with the Repair Agent to schedule a priority service slot. - update_crm_dashboard: Sets ride_booked and repair_scheduled flags.

docs.title: 4. FollowUpAgent
docs.text: Mission: The "Safety Net". - Trigger: Activated via the "Fast Forward 30 Days" simulation. - Tools: - check_repair_status: Verifies service records for completion. - update_crm_dashboard: Escalates stalled safety tickets to human officers if the vehicle remains unrepaired after 30 days.

docs.title: System Architecture
docs.text: The Vigil Insurance ecosystem is built as a multi-agent team using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK).

docs.title: Workflow Overview
docs.text:
The system follows a strict, linear pipeline to ensure safety and data integrity:

  1. Monitor: Scans for recalls and matches them to policyholders.
  2. Triage: Assesses the severity of the specific recall component.
  3. Outreach: Executes autonomous partner dispatches (A2A).
  4. Follow-up: Escalates stalled repairs after a time jump.

docs.text:

    User((User)) -- Trigger Audit --> Backend[FastAPI Backend]

    subgraph ADK Agent Team
        Orchestrator --> Monitor[MonitorAgent]

        Monitor -- "Detect Matches" --> CRM[(CRM state.csv)]

        Orchestrator --> Triage[TriageAgent]

    CRM -- Polling --> Dashboard[React Command Center]
    Activity[(activity.json)] -- Telemetry --> Dashboard

docs.title: Data Persistence
docs.text:
• state.csv: Serves as the single source of truth for policyholder lifecycle states.
  • activity.json: Captures real-time tool execution for the dashboard's "Autonomous Agent Activity" feed.
  • ADK Resumability: Local SQLite-based session storage allows the agent team to remember conversation context across complex workflows.

docs.title: Setup Guide
docs.text: Follow these steps to get the Proactive Safety Agent and Command Center running on your local machine.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.11+
  • Node.js 18+ & npm
  • Google Cloud SDK (gcloud) authenticated with Vertex AI permissions.

docs.title: 1. Clone the Repository
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/couchrishi/vigil-insurance-agent.git
cd vigil-insurance-agent

docs.title: 2. Backend Setup
docs.text:
Create a virtual environment and install the required Python packages: 

python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install pandas uvicorn fastapi google-adk google-genai python-dotenv

docs.title: 3. Frontend Setup
docs.text:
Install the dashboard dependencies: 

cd safety-command-center-main
npm install
cd ..

docs.title: 4. Configuration
docs.text:
Create a .env file in the root directory: 

GOOGLE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=your_project_id
GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=us-central1

docs.title: 1. Reset Data (Optional)
docs.text:
To start with a clean slate (clears CRM and activity logs): 

python3 reset_demo.py

docs.title: 2. Start the Ecosystem
docs.text:
This command launches both the FastAPI backend (port 8081) and the Vite frontend (port 8080): 

python3 start_dashboard.py

Open http://localhost:8080 in your browser to view the Command Center.
